title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Patronage Years and Restore Cushion Days
content:
**Term 1.** For the restore payment of PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), where the member's capital credit records carry distribution-margin allocations (one is booked for each patronage year) for at least 25 patronage years, the cushion days are reduced by 2; where they carry such allocations for at least 10 but fewer than 25 patronage years, the cushion days are reduced by 1; with fewer patronage years they are not reduced.

**Term 2.** The cushion days are never fewer than zero.

**Term 3.** The patronage years are counted from the member's Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) records, one for each distribution-margin allocation booked to the member.

**Illustrations (hypothetical members).**

| Patronage years with a distribution-margin allocation | Cushion days |
|---|---|
| 25 or more, for example 41 | reduced by 2 |
| 10 to 24, for example 10 or 24 | reduced by 1 |
| 9 or fewer | not reduced |

A member with 30 patronage years whose cushion days, before this reduction, stand at 1 ends at 0, not at a figure below zero.
